statements: CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE habits (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, frequency_json TEXT NOT NULL, metric_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL, is_archived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE check_in_records (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, habit_id TEXT NOT NULL, timestamp_utc INTEGER NOT NULL, tz_offset_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, local_date TEXT NOT NULL, value REAL, verification_status TEXT NOT NULL, sync_status TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(habit_id) REFERENCES habits(id))

CREATE TABLE sync_outbox (event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, entity_type TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL, is_synced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
